## Stereo feedback delay, beat-synced to transport ##

The Sync Delay creates a stereo pair of signals out of a single incoming signal. You select the delay time for each channel in musical duration values using the two drop-down menus.

The feedback control sets the amount of feedback within the delay line - with high levels creating overwhelming levels of feedback. The HPF (High Pass Filter) and LPF (Low Pass Filter) allow you to contour the sound of the delay.

The Mix control sets the blend of direct and delayed signal.
